completion_notes: ThemeProvider (src/components/theme-provider.tsx) — client context for dark mode, toggles 'dark' class on <html>, persists to localStorage
Header (src/components/header.tsx) — sticky header with blog name, nav links (Home, Posts, About), dark mode toggle
Footer (src/components/footer.tsx) — copyright and social links placeholder (GitHub, Twitter, Email)
PostCard (src/components/post-card.tsx) — reusable card with title, excerpt, category badge, date, reading time
Pagination (src/components/pagination.tsx) — page controls for post listings with basePath prop
Reading time utility (src/lib/reading-time.ts) — estimateReadingTime(htmlContent) returns minutes at 200 wpm
Post content renderer (src/app/posts/[slug]/post-content.tsx) — client component with highlight.js syntax highlighting for code blocks
Public pages: / (hero + recent posts), /posts (paginated grid), /tags/[slug] (tag filtered), /about
